summary: Sam Beall, 39, of Knoxville, Tennessee, owner of Blackberry Farm, died after a skiing accident on an unspecified intermediate run at Beaver Creek Resort; died at Vail Valley Medical Center.
notes: In-bounds ski-area incident, same class as ids 3282/3469; run unspecified; Thursday 2016-02-25 weekday-verified; Beaver Creek Ski Patrol named in resort statement.
